content.title: What Foxes Eat
content.summary: Foxes **hunt** small animals. They eat fruit too. They bring food to their **den**.
paragraphs: Foxes are smart animals. They eat many kinds of food.
A fox **hunts** at night. It listens for mice under the snow. Then it jumps on its **prey**.
Foxes eat bugs and berries too.
A mother fox brings food to her **den**. Her babies wait for her there.

glossary.definition: to look for and catch animals to eat
glossary.translatedDefinition: buscar y atrapar animales para comer

glossary.definition: an animal that another animal hunts and eats
glossary.example: A mouse is prey for a fox.
glossary.translatedDefinition: un animal que otro animal caza y come

glossary.definition: a hidden home where a wild animal lives
glossary.example: The baby foxes sleep in the den.
glossary.translatedDefinition: una casa escondida donde vive un animal salvaje
